Subject: MAP: acceptance lanes for evaluation assets + usage covenant

Alex — great talking earlier.

Attached is a first-pass mutual action plan for the evaluation exchange. Key asks from our side:
- CedarPoint provides the prompt pack sample (<= 300 prompts) and the seed testcases CSV by 5/21.
- Mark sensitive rows with a classification tag (PII/PHI/Proprietary).
- Sandbox lane will be ephemeral (30 days), limited to our staging hosts; no external redistribution.

High-level schedule proposal:
1) Share prompt pack sample and testcases — 5/21
2) Redwood to ingest and run smoke eval — 5/24–5/26
3) Joint QA pass and acceptance criteria sign-off — by 5/28
4) If accepted, DocuSign MAP and move to pilot — target 6/1

I added a short usage covenant section in the PDF (see RDW-CedarPoint-MAP-v1.3.pdf). Please confirm: are the 30-day ephemeral lanes acceptable and can Procurement review the covenant language?

Thanks — I’ll loop in Lauren for operational runbooks once we have confirmation.

—Rachel

Thanks Rachel — this looks straightforward. A few clarifications from our side:
- We can deliver a 250-prompt sample and a 200-row testcase CSV by COB 5/21.
- We will flag sensitive rows with a column labeled "sensitivity_level" and provide a short descriptor.
- Ephemeral 30-day lanes are fine; we request a retained audit log for the sandbox period (read-only) for compliance.

I'll have Procurement review the covenant text this afternoon; they may propose a small edit around retention language (we'll send redlines).

On timelines: CedarPoint would like the joint QA pass moved earlier if ingestion finishes on 5/24 — can we squeeze QA on 5/25? That would keep the overall runway tight but lets us hit a 6/1 pilot target.
